summary:
Fixed the DataLoader batching issue.

Changed:
- [src/context.ts](/app/src/context.ts): creates request-scoped loaders with `createLoaders(db)`.
- [src/resolvers/userResolver.ts](/app/src/resolvers/userResolver.ts): reuses `ctx.loaders.userLoader` and `ctx.loaders.postsByAuthorLoader`.
- [src/resolvers/postResolver.ts](/app/src/resolvers/postResolver.ts): reuses `ctx.loaders.userLoader`.

`./test.sh` passes. The performance test now reports `Total DB queries executed: 2`, under the `<=15` threshold. Dist files were updated by the test script’s TypeScript compile.
